eps.o: After Zola steals the Community Center's party, the community works together to get it back.
Team Spidey has to figure out where Sandman is hiding a migration of butterflies.
When Hulk is hit with Doc Ock's Obey Ray, Team Spidey must stop him from helping her.
A lemur steals Ant-Man and the Wasp's shrink and grow tech, causing trouble around the city.
Team Spidey saves the Apple Blossom Festival from Gobby's antics.
Zola steals the Spider Crawl-R during a space mission, stranding Spidey and The Thing on the moon.
Team Spidey stops Doc Ock from melting ice while looking for treasure in Antarctica.

eps.t: Let It Snowball, Let It Snowball, Let It Snowball
eps.o: When Zola claims the snowy park as his, Miles and his dad work together to take it back.
Spidey and Ghosty save the Bubble Festival from Gobby's super strong bubbles.
Spidey and Ant-Man save Aunt May's doll when it gets washed down a storm drain.
Team Spidey helps a mama goose get back to its baby.
When Lockjaw chases Black Cat through the city causing trouble, Team Spidey must help him make things right.
Team Spidey, Ant-Man, and Wasp must shrink a giant Zola back to regular size.
Gobby and Rhino try to ruin Valentine's Day.

eps.t: Now You See Me, Now You Don't
eps.o: Team Spidey stops invisible Rhino from doing sneaky crimes all across town.
Team Spidey teams up with hero Squirrel Girl to stop Green Goblin's Naughty Nutty Ray.
Team Spidey stops Gobby from taking control of the vehicles.
Team Spidey helps the tortoises by defeating Sandman's giant sandcastle.
Zola shrinks the city's cars...and Detective Stacy!
Rhino mistakes Wasp for the Tooth Fairy.
Team Spidey must save the art show when Zola steals artwork from the museum.
Spidey and Black Panther must catch runaway new tech lost in the city before Doc Ock finds it.
Team Spidey helps the city when Zola becomes a superhero like Iron Man.
Aunt May's birthday balloon ride strands her, Spidey, and Gobby on an island.
Doc Ock's new invention turns people into frozen statues.
Team Spidey must save Jeff when he accidentally tries on Spidey's new Web-Spinner boots.
Zola steals the Bookmobile and the writer, Millicent McKeen.
The villains team up to steal back their old inventions from the museum’s new exhibit.
With the help of Reptil, Team Spidey gets new dino powers to defeat Gobby's Dino-Mech.
Team Spidey must stop a ghost that's stealing from the museum.
Lizard’s monster plant takes over the city.
Doc Ock captures the Spider CRAWL-R while on a mission in Space, so Miles and his mom, Rio, work together to free their ship.
Gobby's dino-mech takes over a natural geyser.
Lizard brings dinosaurs to life in the museum.
Team Spidey and White Tiger must stop Gobby and Rhino from mining in a ringtail's habitat.
When Trapster traps Spidey, he must get help from friends with big ideas.
Team Spidey searches for Mr. Von Carnegie, who is fossil hunting in an active volcano.
When Lizard super-sizes bugs in town, Team Spidey and White Tiger team up to stop him.
Spidey and Doc Ock fall into Trapster's trap, and the only way out is to work together.
Spidey and The Thing search for a friend's missing chess piece.

eps.t: The Curse of the Corn Dog King
eps.o: The Corn Dog King haunts the Amusement Park, ruining the Halloween fun.
Zola puts grown-ups under a spell to get them to bring him all the Halloween candy.
When Zola duplicates himself, the Spidey team must figure out how to turn him back to one Zola.
Electro makes electricity-stealing lightning bugs to steal the city's electricity.
Team Spidey faces their robot selves created by Doc Ock.
Lizard's potion is turning Black Cat into a saber-toothed tiger unless Team Spidey can turn her back to normal.
When Gobby, Electro, and Rhino get dino powers, they take over the Dino-Web Tree House.
Spidey must catch a tiny Zola loose in Aunt May's house.

eps.t: Moon Girl and the Dino Dilemma
eps.o: The Spideys team up with Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur to stop Green Goblin's dino-mech!
When Doc Ock swaps Hulk into the body of a squirrel, hero Squirrel Girl helps save him.

eps.t: A Snow Day for Aunt May
eps.o: Team Spidey wants to give Aunt May a snow day for Christmas, but first must help Santa Claus!
The Thing and Spidey help Aunt Petunia rescue her stolen latkes on Hanukkah.
With help from Herbie, Spidey and The Thing must stop Trapster's hidden traps from catching people.
Gobby and Rhino steal Spidey's invention.
Team Spidey must rescue the legendary Bigfoot, who gets caught in Trapster's trap.
Gobby's dino-mech creates metal Gobbybots that cause chaos in the city.
